points.description: States the maximum average annual precipitation (mean of the annual maximum precipitation series) as a parameter influencing PMP estimation.
States the standard deviation of the annual maximum precipitation series as the second parameter influencing PMP estimation.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both parameters named precisely: the mean of annual maximum precipitation and its standard deviation. Each is worth one mark and is all or nothing. Vague answers such as "rainfall" or "variability", or wrong parameters like skewness or area, earn nothing for that point; a wrong extra item costs the point it is attached to.
